title: Move-in: energy and internet contracts start
impact: Contracts should start on the key-handover date; note the meter readings that day.

title: New energy tax rates (Belastingplan 2027)
impact: Changes every supplier's all-in kWh price by the same amount; rate added to config.json once published.

title: New Liander grid tariffs
impact: Same for every supplier; ACM publishes them in November/December.

title: Net metering (salderingsregeling) ends
impact: Solar feed-in no longer offsets usage; each supplier's feed-in payment and fees decide what panels earn.
